waiting_room.text: A door made of a stop sign. Inside, {{doc_name}} is elbow-deep in something that used to bark. 'Sit, sit,' they say, not looking up. 'Everyone's got a bug going around. I fixed it. Mostly.'

demonstration.text: {{doc_name}} uncorks a jar that smells like a dare. 'Expired Meds, boiled down proper. That's the base for near everything I make here.' They scrawl a ratio on a rib bone and hand it over.

bandage_notes.text: 'Clean underwear, if you've got it,' {{doc_name}} says, not even a little embarrassed. 'Boiled with the meds, it wraps like a dream. Don't ask about the smell.'

choices.label: Ask about the back room, where the screaming was coming from.

back_room.text: A survivor with a leg wrapped in something that used to squelch and now just sits there, cured. 'Fur and meds,' {{doc_name}} says proudly. 'Keeps infection out. Wraps ugly, works clean.'

choices.label: Ask what's behind the second curtain.

deeper_room.text: Behind the curtain, a paste the color of a bruise sits in an unmarked jar. 'Corrosive syrup, cut with meds,' {{doc_name}} explains. 'Draws the glow out through the skin. Ugly. Works.'

wrong_jar.text: You knock over the wrong jar. Whatever was in it is now on you.

patient_zero.text: The 'patient' sits up faster than anything cured should. You leave without asking again.

syrup_spill.text: A jar of something corrosive tips as you reach past it. It finds skin before you can pull back.
